test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.

A. He swore that the eight thousand roubles that he had were his own money.

B. He had not seen the merchant after they had tea together.

C. Aksenov swore that he had not killed the merchant.

D. But his voice was broken and he trembled with fear as though he were guilty.
solution:
The correct answer is **'CBAD'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**When we read the jumbled sentences, we get to know that they are related to the part of the story where Aksenov swore for something that he didn't do.

__
 
• The first sentence states that Aksenov swore for something, and that is **(C) - *Aksenov swore that he had not killed the merchant.***
 
• The second sentence clarifies more with reason, and that is **(B) - *He had not seen the merchant after they had tea together.***
 
• The third sentence states that he swore for one more this, and that is **(A) - *He swore that the eight thousand roubles that he had were his own money.***
 
• Now we are left with the fourth sentence, obviously, that is **(D) - *But his voice was broken and he trembled with fear as though he were guilty.***

The above-mentioned detail shows that the sequence should be '**CBAD'.**

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's understand the **meaning of given words in the sentences.**

 
• **Merchant - *a person whose job is to buy and sell products in large amounts, especially by trading with other countries.***
 
• **Tremble - *to shake slightly in a way that you cannot control.***
